title: Scrimline convergence inventory (lite)
body:
Purpose: quick, shareable tracker to map small convergence workstreams across teams and capture immediate shortfall estimates. Use this as a scratchpad for coordination, not the final SLA doc.

Topline notes:
- Created to intake ad-hoc requests that touch serving runtime, product console, and platform infra.
- Goal: identify the minimal owner + 1 quick mitigation for each friction, and an effort tier (S/M/L).
- Update cadence: daily during the week of the spike, then 2x/week until resolved.

Mini inventory (rows = items for cross-team sync):
1) Route throttle misattribution | Owner: Liam Chen | Teams: infra, serving-runtime | Shortfall: routing tag mismatch in prod -> bursts miscounted | Quick fix: pin rate-limit metric to route-id (2-4h) | Effort: S
2) Canary rollback flakiness | Owner: Priya Rao | Teams: console, release-eng | Shortfall: rollback fails if older model missing kv-index | Quick fix: add preflight that verifies model index (4-8h) | Effort: M
3) Regional fallback mapping gaps | Owner: Tomás Fernández | Teams: platform-eng, private-deploys | Shortfall: EU->NA fallback missing for dedicated pools | Quick fix: add route-policy override (6-12h) | Effort: M
4) Low-confidence eval spike | Owner: Aisha Patel | Teams: applied-ml, product-hosted-api | Shortfall: sudden increase in regen rate -> cost surge | Quick fix: temporarily reduce regen throttle and enable cached prefixes (1-2h) | Effort: S

Quick priority rubric (handy):
- Severity: user-impacting > cost-impacting > analytic-only
- Effort tiers: S (under 4h), M (4-12h), L (>12h)
- Ownership: always list primary + backup

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Who will own post-mitigation postmortems for regional fallback? (suggested: platform-eng ops lead)
- Do we need a temporary SLA adjustment for next 72h if cost drift continues? (Finance/RevOps input)
- Is there a quick telemetry dashboard we can toggle to track regen rate live? (obs team)

Action log (short):
- 2026-11-17 09:15 APT: Created initial rows from on-call notes.
- 2026-11-17 10:02 LC: Pinned route tag metric, deployed to staging.
- 2026-11-18 16:40 PR: Added preflight check PR #5232 (release-eng).
- 2026-11-19 08:30 TF: Confirmed fallback policy patch rolling to canary.

Next steps (this doc):
- Owners to update status field in tracker when mitigation is deployed.
- Product-ops to re-evaluate priority after 48h.
- If cost or latency drift persists, escalate to ops rota with marker "escalate: scrimline".

Notes to self: keep this lean. If item requires >12h, spin into a short ticket with acceptance criteria and link back here.

End of sheet (lightweight) - drop comments inline as you go.
summary: Compact ad-hoc tracker to reconcile cross-team friction points, assign owners and quick fixes, and capture effort tiers for immediate remediation.
